crossRefs.note: Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

translations.web: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.
translations.kjv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
translations.asv: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Jehovah.
